package design

import . "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"

var data = Type("Data", func() {

	Field(1, "id", String)
	OneOf("choice", func() {
		Field(2, "left", String)
		Field(3, "right", Int)
	})
	Example(map[string]any{"id": "authored-id"})

})
var _ = Service("svc", func() {

	Method("send", func() {
		Payload(data, func() {
			Example(map[string]any{"id": "authored-id"})
		})
		GRPC(func() {

		})
	})

})
